rightsContext: Official public promotional catalogue artwork identifies each work being reviewed in original historical commentary. Reduced 800x988 WebP, unchanged composition, credit and link; rights reserved. This is contextual editorial quotation/review, not a claim of an open or commercial reuse licence. Rockstar legal page was accessible only as a JavaScript shell, so no blanket permission is inferred. No AI, leaks, mods or GTA V art labelled as VI. Existing unedited official GTA VI hero retained.
limitations: London 1961 uses clearly identified London 1969 parent-product art, because the official catalogue has no separate 1961 artwork. Caption explicitly explains this in all languages.
Advance uses the official catalogue’s logo, explicitly labelled promotional logo, not gameplay.
GTA VI unreleased: only publicly announced premise and development chronology; no invented ending, mission list or final review.
Chronology dates limited to verified years when sources differ on regional original release dates. GTA 2 story year left unspecified.

No direct playthrough is claimed; factual plot corroborated with referenced published histories. Official catalogue pages are JavaScript shells with accessible title/description; full article bodies not inferred from that access.
guardrails: Previous 52 topics and paths preserved. No ad units, subscriptions, security, Analytics consent, AdSense verification, hero animation or automation schedule changed. No BarberControl work.
